name: AnyModelBot
tagline: AI robot team that runs on your computer
description: AnyModelBot is an open‑source desktop application for Windows, macOS and Linux, also available as Docker and CLI. It lets users create multiple AI agents, each with its own model and persistent markdown memory stored locally. Agents can chat, run code, handle files, generate images or short videos, and more, while model usage is billed per token through Modelflare. A single API key provides access to 68 models from 11 providers. The app itself is free, with no subscription, and new users receive a $1 credit for initial model usage.
best_for: creating quick images or short videos

free_tier.notes: Free app; model usage billed per token after the $1 credit.
